Session 49 (finding 2): the REAL cassette player, finally on the shelf. Session 32 tried to do this by putting `model: cassettePlayer` on an r1 OVERRIDE of the box-built `boombox` prop — but clusterMorph.ts's fold only copies color/pos/size out of `props` overrides, so the key was silently dropped and the shelf kept showing an anonymous dark box (the 418KB GLB was downloaded and never used). Overrides still cannot introduce a model; an ADD can (foldTargets passes def.model, and spawnTarget spawns it), which is how deskModel/chairModel/bookcaseModel already work. So the four box props are removed above and this replaces them. pos/size are Session 32's own measured values, kept verbatim: centered in the bookcase's rendered depth (x:[1.623,2.098]) with clearance on both shelf edges; `size` remains the fallback-box geometry if the GLB ever fails to load. Cross-checked against book1 (era1.json, undisputed correct placement for 17+ sessions): its base is 1.10, matching board 3's top (1.102) almost exactly, confirming the method. The boombox/tapes/cdStack/teddyBox compartment is the one BELOW that (bounded by the board at 0.646-0.703), so its floor is 0.703, not 0.76 — every prop on this shelf was resting 5.7cm above its actual surface the whole time, which finally read as visibly wrong (Sérgio: 'the boombax is too up', 'a floating yellow tape') once the boombox stopped being a thin tower and started reading as a real object.
